classification.difficultyReason: Choose equal or supplementary parallel-line angle relations and solve equations with coefficients and constants.

content.prompt: Work out the value of the pronumerals in each of these diagrams.

spec.description: Two gently rising parallel lines crossed by a descending transversal. Upper lower-right angle 66° and lower upper-left angle 2a are alternate interior angles.

answer.worked:
Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}2a&=66^\circ\\a&=33^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two descending parallel lines crossed by a steep rising transversal. Corresponding right-side obtuse sectors are labelled 123° and 3b.

answer.worked:
Corresponding angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}3b&=123^\circ\\b&=41^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rising parallel lines crossed by a steep rising transversal. Upper-left exterior obtuse sector is 124°; lower-left exterior acute sector is 4c.
spec.mathematics: Marked sectors are supplementary: 4c+124°=180°. Printed answer c=31° conflicts with these sectors.
spec.answerVisibility: Preserve both source givens and their sectors; no completed answer in diagram.

answer.worked:
The corresponding angle at the lower intersection is $124^\circ$. Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}4c+124^\circ&=180^\circ\\4c&=56^\circ\\c&=14^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rising parallel lines crossed by a descending transversal. Upper below-line obtuse sector 4d and lower upper-left acute sector 2d are co-interior.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on parallel lines sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}4d+2d&=180^\circ\\6d&=180^\circ\\d&=30^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Descending parallel lines and steep rising transversal. Upper right obtuse sector is (3e+10)°; lower bottom acute sector is (2e−15)°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given algebraic angle labels are visible.

answer.worked:
The corresponding angle at the lower intersection is $(3e+10)^\circ$. It and $(2e-15)^\circ$ form a straight angle.
$$\begin{align*}(3e+10)+(2e-15)&=180\\5e-5&=180\\5e&=185\\e&=37\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two near-vertical parallel lines, with upward parallel marks below a slightly descending transversal. Left upper-left sector is (4f−25)°; right lower-left sector is (2f+40)°.
spec.mathematics: (4f−25)+(2f+40)=180; f=55/2=27.5. Source appends ° to the answer.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given algebraic angle labels are visible.

answer.worked:
The corresponding angle at the right intersection is $(4f-25)^\circ$. It and $(2f+40)^\circ$ form a straight angle.
$$\begin{align*}(4f-25)+(2f+40)&=180\\6f+15&=180\\6f&=165\\f&=\frac{55}{2}\\f&=27.5\end{align*}$$
